notes.title: Patch 28042022 - Improvement of Life
notes.notes:
Improvement of life Update

Changes : 

- Changed Game name to Stream Games Deluxe so not be confused with Metal Gear Solid
- Improved all menus 
- Added How to plays
- Changed Speed of Runner
- Dropper, changed speeds of dropping of platforms
- Auto adding streamer to game through options and auto starting
- Many Other Changes implemented

More to Come soon.

notes.title: Demo Coming very soon
notes.notes:
Although the demo button is available, if you click it and nothing happens please be patient whilst the demo is undergoing the Steam process and should be available very soon.

The demo is a basic game of bowling, no scoring. It is timed also.

The demo doe snot reflect the final quality of the game and is more to get feedback on how you think it goes together.
